questions.stem: The marketing team will ----- the new campaign until customer feedback has been reviewed.
questions.zh_stem: 在审阅客户反馈之前，市场团队将 ----- 新活动。
questions.rationale: will + 原形动词 → postpone。A 分词、C 名词、D 带 to 不定式都不对。

questions.stem: All visitors must present ----- identification at the security desk before entering the laboratory.
questions.zh_stem: 所有访客进入实验室前必须在安检台出示 ----- 证件。
questions.rationale: 修饰名词 identification 用形容词 valid。

questions.stem: Ms. Ortega was praised for completing the audit ----- ahead of the deadline.
questions.zh_stem: Ortega 女士因在截止日期之前很好地完成审计而受到表扬。
questions.rationale: 修饰动词 completing 的方式状语用副词 well，不用形容词 good。

questions.stem: Please submit your travel receipts ----- seven days of returning from the conference.
questions.zh_stem: 请在会议返回后 ----- 七天内提交差旅发票。
questions.rationale: within + 时间段 = 在…之内。

questions.stem: The factory's output has increased ----- since the new assembly line was installed.
questions.zh_stem: 自新装配线安装以来，工厂产量 ----- 增长。
questions.rationale: 修饰动词 increased 用副词 dramatically。

questions.stem: Neither the director ----- the assistants were available to take the call.
questions.zh_stem: 导演 ----- 助手都无法接听电话。
